divisions.headline: And in the end, the attendance issues were all on the Appetite side, with Jonesing finally finding all their guys and posting a critical win; Element handles Dart Attack, then takes a full-on 501 nap; Darty takes down Beach, jumps into the #4 slot
Serious stays perfect with plodding win over the Bottoms; Kids win their 3rd straight to remain within one of the lead; Angry Birds hit the win column, outrunning Inconsistent

Area wins big to stay undefeated (and reach their 33rd straight win over three seasons); Ducks yank Menace from the ranks of the unbeaten; Mafia squeezes by Projectile, Secrets outlast the Pints, and both move above 0.500 in C's top four

Point & Rally races past McGavin to reach 5-0; the Knights slowly pull away from the Bandits to keep hold of 2nd; Sanchez gets critical 1001 win over Niners to lock in top-3 spot; Stumble also uses an extra leg, dropping Bullies to bottom pair
What's the Point wins battle of unbeatens, Shooting down the Blanks; Dartness wins the last three sets big over Off Constantly; Mayhem busts tie with Arrows via doubles sweep
Two Time rips five doubles to hand shorthanded Death Throw their first loss; Cheap Shots win 4th straight, take over F lead; Shooters grab first win, topping shorthanded Nein
Rippin rolls again, scoring 16+ every week so far; Aim-ing rides cricket edge to drop Banging from the undefeated group; Machine ekes past We Throw It, ending 3-match slide

SofaKings trail Bright Side early, sweep doubles to push Bright two back; Double Vision barely ekes past winless Calm, but stays undefeated nonetheless; Dirty Darts, Rangers both win, joining trio of 3-2 teams sitting in the middle of H race
